svg.title: Inventory system ERD
svg.desc: Entity relationship diagram of the multi-tenant inventory and sales database: stores, users, categories, products, suppliers, customers, purchase and sales invoices with their items, and stock movements.
svg.text: Arrows point to the referenced table. Eight tables carry store_id (FK to stores.id), so every record belongs to one store.
stock_movements.reference_id is a plain integer column with no foreign key.
